raced near side, midfield, headway and led under 2f out, kept on but headed towards finish, 2nd of 6 in group
raced near side, led, headed and prominent after 1f, outpaced 2f out, stayed on and went third again inside final furlong, no match for first two, 3rd of 6 in group
slowly away, raced far side, in rear, ran on and went modest fourth inside final 110yds, 1st of 2 in group
dwelt start, raced near side, in rear, took keen hold and led after 1f, headed under 2f out, weakened final furlong, 4th of 6 in group
took keen hold, raced far side, prominent, switched to near side over 4f out, lost position halfway, weakened final furlong, 5th of 6 in group
raced near side, in touch with leaders, weakened final furlong, 6th of 6 in group
awkward start, raced far side, prominent, weakened from over 2f out, 2nd of 2 in group (jockey said gelding weakened quickly inside the final 2 furlongs; vet reported gelding was lame behind)
